purpose: bounded read-and-fix review of all canonical t(...) pairs in the five early Angolwen/Ardhungol chat sections
note: Every canonical t(...) pair in the listed sections is in scope. No entry is asserted defective. Host source verification decides. args_order is recorded per call.

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A tall woman stands before you. Her fair skin radiates incredible power through her white robe.*#WHITE#
I am Linaniil of the Kar'Krul. Welcome to our city, @playerdescriptor.subclass@. What may I do for thee?
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名身材高大的女子伫立在你面前。她白皙的肌肤透过白袍散发着惊人的力量。*#WHITE#
我是卡·克鲁尔的莱娜尼尔。欢迎来到我们的城市，@playerdescriptor.subclass@。我能为你做些什么？

items.source: I require all the help I can get, not for my sake but for the town of Derth, to the northeast of here.
items.target: 我需要能得到的所有帮助，不是为了我自己，而是为了此地东北方的德斯镇。

items.source: I am ready! Send me to Urkis!
items.target: 我准备好了！送我去厄奇斯那里！

items.source: Urkis has been slain.
items.target: 厄奇斯已被诛杀。

items.source: Nothing for now. Sorry to have taken your time. Farewell, my lady.
items.target: 暂时无事。抱歉耽误了您的时间。告辞，女士。

items.source:
Yes, we have noticed the devastation that happened there. I have sent some friends thence to disperse the cloud, but the true threat lies not there.
He who created this abomination is Urkis. He is a Tempest, a powerful Archmage who channels the storms.
Years ago he went rogue, severing himself from Angolwen. At first he remained quiet, and thus we withheld action, but it seems we have no choice now.
Cleansing the skies will take much time. In the meanwhile, if thou art willing, we can send thee to Urkis' lair to face him.
I will not lie to thee: we can send thee thence, but this could be a death trap, and we have no means for thou to depart his lair, as he lives atop a tall peak in the Daikara mountains.
items.target:
是的，我们已经注意到了那里所遭受的破坏。我已派了几位同伴前往该处驱散阴云，但真正的威胁并不在那里。
造就这桩灾祸的是厄奇斯。他是一名风暴法师，一位能够引导风暴的强大元素法师。
数年前他背离正道，断绝了与安格利文的联系。起初他一直保持沉寂，因此我们未予干预，但如今看来我们已别无选择。
净化天空需要耗费诸多时日。在此期间，若你愿意，我们可将你送往厄奇斯的巢穴，由你亲自直面他。
我不会对你有所隐瞒：我们固然能将你送去那里，但这可能是一处死亡陷阱；并且由于他隐居在岱卡拉山脉的高峰之巅，我们无法将你从他的巢穴中接引离开。

items.source: I need to prepare myself. I will be back soon.
items.target: 我需要先做些准备。我很快就会回来。

items.source: I am ready. Send me. I will not let the good people of Derth down.
items.target: 我准备好了。送我过去吧。我不会辜负德斯镇善良的居民。

items.source: Good luck to thee. Thou hast the blessings of Angolwen.
items.target: 祝你好运。安格利文的祝福与你同在。

items.source: Thank you.
items.target: 谢谢。

items.source: I see the storm is calmed.  Take this rune as a token of my appreciation.
items.target: 我见风暴已经平息。请收下这枚符文，作为我的谢礼。

items.source: Welcome @playername@ to my shop.
items.target: @playername@，欢迎来到我的商店。

items.source: Let me see your wares.
items.target: 让我看看你的商品吧。

items.source: I am looking for staff training.
items.target: 我想寻求法杖战斗训练。

items.source: Sorry, I have to go!
items.target: 抱歉，我得走了！

items.source: I can teach you staff combat (talent category Spell/Staff combat).  Learning the basics costs 100 gold, while more intensive tutelage to gain proficiency costs 500 gold.  Once you're proficient, I can teach you more refined techniques for an additional 750 gold.
items.target: 我可以传授你法杖格斗技巧（技能类别：法术/法杖格斗）。学习基础需要 100 金币，而获得熟练掌握的深入指导则需 500 金币。一旦你达到熟练，只需额外支付 750 金币，我便能传授你更精湛的技巧。

items.source: Just give me the basics (reveals locked talent category) - 100 gold.
items.target: 只学习基础（揭示锁定的技能树）- 100 金币。

items.source: The staff carver spends some time with you, teaching you the basics of staff combat.
items.target: 制杖师花了一些时间指导你，向你传授法杖格斗的基础技巧。

items.source: He is surprised at how quickly you are able to follow his tutelage.
items.target: 他对你能如此迅速领会他的指导感到惊讶。

items.source: Please teach me what I need to know (unlocks talent category) - %d gold.
items.target: 请传授我所需知晓的一切（解锁技能类别）- %d 金币。

items.source: The staff carver spends a substantial amount of time teaching you all of the techniques of staff combat.
items.target: 制杖师花了大量时间指导你，向你传授法杖格斗的全部技巧。

items.source: He is impressed with your mastery and shows you a few extra techniques.
items.target: 他对你的熟练程度印象深刻，并向你展示了一些额外技巧。

items.source: I'm already proficient, but I want to be an expert (improves talent mastery by 0.2) - 750 gold.
items.target: 我已经学会了，但我想成为一名专家。(增加技能树系数0.2) - 750 金币。

items.source: The staff carver spends a great deal of time going over the finer details of staff combat with you%s.
items.target: 制杖师花了大量时间与你一同推敲法杖格斗的精妙细节%s。

items.source: , including some esoteric techniques
items.target: ，包括一些秘传技巧

items.source: No thanks.
items.target: 不用了，谢谢。

items.source: #{italic}##LIGHT_GREEN#*As you drink the potion, your runes start to burn as they fade away, and a terrible agony seems to sink through your skin to your bones, muscles, and heart.  You black out from the pain, and come to a bit later, the runes gone forever.  You feel very ill, and yet...  cleansed.*#{normal}##WHITE#
items.target: #{italic}##LIGHT_GREEN#*当你饮下药剂，身上的符文在逐渐消逝时灼烧起来，一股可怕的剧痛仿佛穿透你的肌肤，深嵌进骨骼、肌肉与心脏。你在剧痛中昏厥过去，稍后苏醒时，符文已永远消失。你感到极度虚弱不适，然而……却又感到被洗涤净化。*#{normal}##WHITE#

items.source:
Excellent! You truly prove that no mage-wrought flame or storm can stand against blade and arrow! Come, learn our ways. You are ready.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*he gives you a potion.*#WHITE#
Drink this. We extract it from a very rare kind of drake. It will grant you powers to fight and cancel magic, but never again will you be able to use magic.%s
items.target:
干得漂亮！你切实证明了，任何法师造就的烈焰或风暴都敌不过刀剑与利箭！来吧，领会我们的道路。你已经做好了准备。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他递给你一瓶药剂。*#WHITE#
喝下它。这是我们从一种极为罕见的龙类身上提取而成的。它将赋予你对抗并消除魔法的力量，但自此之后你将再也无法使用魔法。%s

items.source: Thank you. I shall not let magic triumph! #LIGHT_GREEN#[you drink the potion]
items.target: 多谢。我绝不会让魔法得逞！ #LIGHT_GREEN#[你喝下了药剂]

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*As the monstrous spider falls you see something... moving in her belly until it explodes! A tall black man steps out of the spewed guts, surrounded by a golden light.*#WHITE#
By the Sun! I thought I would never again see a friendly face!
Thank you. I am Rashim, and I am in your debt.
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*随着那只巨蛛轰然倒下，你看到有什么东西……在它的腹部蠕动，直到猛然炸开！一名高大的黑肤男子从喷溅的内脏中迈步走出，周身环绕着金色光芒。*#WHITE#
太阳在上！我原以为自己再也见不到一张友善的面孔了！
多谢你。我是拉希姆，我欠你一份恩情。

items.source: I have been sent by your wife. She was worried for you.
items.target: 我是受你妻子之托而来的。她非常担心你的安危。

items.source:
Ah, my dear heart!
Well, now that I am free I will create a portal to the Gates of Morning. I think I've seen enough spiders for the rest of my life.
items.target:
啊，我亲爱的心上人！
好了，既然现在我已脱困，我这就开启一道通往晨曦之门的传送门。我想我这辈子见过的蜘蛛已经足够多了。

items.source: Lead the way!
items.target: 请带路吧！

items.source: Good day to you.
items.target: 祝你日安。

items.source: Good day to you too.
items.target: 也祝你日安。

items.source: I have heard you are a great hero of the west. Could you help me, please?
items.target: 我听说你是来自西方的伟大英雄。能否请你帮帮我？

items.source: Maybe, what is it about?
items.target: 也许可以，所为何事？

items.source: I have got enough problems sorry.
items.target: 我自己的麻烦已经够多了，抱歉。

items.source: Welcome back, @playername@.
items.target: 欢迎回来，@playername@。

items.source: I have found your husband. I take it he made it home safely?
items.target: 我找到你的丈夫了。想必他已经安全到家了吧？

items.source: I've got to go. Bye.
items.target: 我得走了。再见。

items.source:
My husband, Rashim, is a Sun Paladin. He was sent to clear the spider lair of Ardhungol to the north of this town.
It has been three days now. He should be back by now. I have a feeling something terrible has happened to him. Please find him!
He should have a magical stone given by the Anorithil to create a portal back here, yet he did not use it!
items.target:
我的丈夫拉希姆是一名太阳骑士。他被派去清理本镇北方的阿尔德胡格蜘蛛巢穴。
如今已经过去三天了。按理说他现在早该回来了。我有一种不祥的预感，他一定是遭遇了可怕的不测。求求你帮我找到他！
他身上本该携带着星月术士所赠的魔法石，用来开启返回此地的传送门，可他却一直没有使用！

items.source: I will see if I can find him.
items.target: 我去看看能否找到他。

items.source: Spiders? Eww, sorry, but he is probably dead now.
items.target: 蜘蛛？恶……抱歉，但他现在恐怕凶多吉少了。

items.source: Yes, yes he did! He said he would have died if not for you.
items.target: 是的，他确实平安回来了！他说若不是有你相救，他早就没命了。

items.source: It was nothing.
items.target: 举手之劳而已。
